facts.text: BundlePaths.ToBundle converts a path to bundle form by replacing the backslash character with a forward slash.
BundlePaths.Resolve seeds its segment list with every part of the from path except the last one.
BundlePaths.Resolve skips a target part that is empty or a single dot.
BundlePaths.Resolve removes the last kept segment for a .. part only while segments remain.
BundlePaths.Resolve silently drops a .. part that has no earlier segment to remove, so a link above the bundle root cannot escape it.
ToBundle_ConvertsWindowsSeparators asserts subjects\login\facts\a.md becomes subjects/login/facts/a.md.
Resolve_YieldsSlashJoinedBundleRelativePath expects the target ../shards/1.md#a from index/1.md to resolve to shards/1.md#a.
Resolve_YieldsSlashJoinedBundleRelativePath expects subjects\s\index.md with target facts\f.md to resolve to subjects/s/facts/f.md.
Resolve_YieldsSlashJoinedBundleRelativePath expects ../../t/facts/g.md from subjects/s/facts/f.md to resolve to subjects/t/facts/g.md.
Resolve_YieldsSlashJoinedBundleRelativePath expects a target of ./c.md from a/b.md to resolve to a/c.md.
Jsonl.WriteBlob hashes the UTF-8 bytes with SHA256 and writes them under Store.BlobRoot named by the lower-case hex string.
Jsonl.Seed posts a subject My App of kind app with aliases the app and myapp.
Jsonl.Seed writes the pin JSON with repo https://example.test/app.git and rev abc123 using a raw UPDATE subjects statement.
Jsonl.Seed posts header-a as 60 pixels tall and then as 64 pixels tall, so the first value is superseded.
Jsonl.Seed attaches refs with rel supports for a fact, defines for a slot, about for a subject and see for a url.
Jsonl.Seed attaches shots/Home Screen.PNG as image/png with perceptual hash algo phash and value ff00.
Jsonl.Records splits each data file on newline and drops the last element before parsing every remaining line as JSON.
Jsonl.Fails throws InvalidOperationException with the message expected a DossierRequestException when the action does not throw.
Jsonl.Cli runs Dossier.dll under dotnet and sets the DOSSIER_DB environment variable when a database path is given.
Jsonl.Manifest parses manifest.json from the bundle directory into a cloned JsonElement.
Jsonl.Publish defaults the publish format to jsonl and sets Now to a fixed DateTimeOffset of 2026, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 with TimeSpan.Zero.
Jsonl.DataFiles enumerates dossier data files by pattern and returns their file names ordered with StringComparer.Ordinal.
Import_RestoresIdsTextsAndRefs compares the imported rows against the source rows after excluding facts whose status is superseded or retracted.
Import_RestoresIdsTextsAndRefs asserts that the import reports 0 skipped entries and that result.Refs is 4.
Import_RestoresIdsTextsAndRefs asserts the supports fact ref points at the target fact's original id rather than the bundle key.
Import_RestoresAttachments checks that the blob file exists at BlobRoot keyed by the shot sha and that its SHA256 hex equals that sha.
Import_RestoresAttachments asserts result.Attachments is 1 and result.Blobs is 1 and the attachments row keeps filename, mime and perceptual metadata.
Import_FailsClosedOnDuplicateLiveSlot forges a second fact file with id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 and expects code import_slot_conflict naming both ids.
Import_RejectsBundleWithoutFactFiles publishes with facts set to none and expects code bundle_has_no_facts with a message mentioning --facts detail.
ImportTests.Facts reads id, subject_id, kind, key, text and status from the facts table ordered by id.
at: SELECT id, subject_id, kind, key, text, status FROM facts ORDER BY id

facts.text: ImportTests.Refs joins every selected refs column with a pipe and renders a NULL value as a tilde.
ImportTests.Fails throws InvalidOperationException with a message saying it expected the import to fail when no DossierRequestException is raised.
at: throw new InvalidOperationException("expected the import to fail with a DossierRequestException")

facts.text: Import_RestoresIdsTextsAndRefs asserts 2 subjects, aliases the app and myapp, a pin containing abc123 and 1 slot row.
RoundTrip_PublishImportPublishIsIdentical imports a bundle into a fresh database, republishes it, and compares every file byte for byte except README.md.
RoundTrip_PublishImportPublishIsIdentical compares README.md only after StripGeneratedAt replaces the Generated at line with a placeholder X.
Import_FailsClosedOnDuplicateLiveSlot asserts the failed import leaves 0 facts and 0 subjects behind.
Import_SkipsFactFileWithoutMachineRecordAndSaysWhy truncates a fact file at its Machine record heading and expects 1 skipped entry whose reason mentions Machine record.
Import_SkipsFactFileWithoutMachineRecordAndSaysWhy expects result.Facts to be one less than the source live fact count.
Import_RestoresIdsTextsAndRefs asserts that the restored fact rows are sequence equal to the filtered source rows.
RoundTrip_PublishImportPublishIsIdentical asserts that both bundles expose the same relative paths in ordinal order.
RoundTrip_PublishImportPublishIsIdentical asserts the first bundle holds more than 10 files before comparing contents.
ImportTests.PublishTo stamps every publish with the command line dossier publish --out bundle.
at: private const string CommandLine = "dossier publish --out bundle"

facts.text: ImportTests.Seed stores the screenshot bytes under BlobRoot by their lower-case SHA256 and reuses that sha in the attachment.
at: var shot = WriteBlob(db, "screenshot bytes for the round trip");

facts.text: JsonlRound2Tests.RequireUnix marks the running test skipped with the reason Unix-only when the host is Windows.
JsonlRound2Tests.EndlessStream throws InvalidOperationException once it has served past 1 GiB, with a message saying the reader is unbounded.
at: read past 1 GiB: the reader is unbounded

facts.text: JsonlRound2Tests.Sha returns the lower-case hex SHA256 of the supplied bytes.
Import_LargeEmbeddedAssetStaysWithinAllocationBudget replaces the asset record with 8 times 1024 times 1024 random bytes and fixes the manifest file_stats bytes and sha256.
Import_LargeEmbeddedAssetStaysWithinAllocationBudget asserts that the import allocates less than 6.5 times the longest asset line length.
ReadAtMost_StopsOnAnEndlessStream expects DossierStore.ReadAtMost to return null and the stream to serve fewer than 8192 bytes.
CopyAtMost_StopsAtTheDeclaredBytes expects CopyAtMost to return false and write 100_000 bytes while the endless stream serves fewer than 300_000.
CopyAtMost_StopsAtTheDeclaredBytes expects a stream of exactly 500 bytes with a limit of 500 to return true and copy 500 bytes.
IsHiddenEntry_TreatsDotFilesAsHiddenOnEveryPlatform expects .DS_Store to be hidden and a.bin not hidden under FileAttributes.Normal.
IsHiddenEntry_TreatsDotFilesAsHiddenOnEveryPlatform expects both the Hidden and the System file attribute to mark an entry hidden.
Import_HiddenFileUnderAssetsIsSkippedAndReported adds assets/.DS_Store after publish and expects 1 blob and a hidden_file_ignored skip reason ending in .DS_Store.
Import_NonHiddenUnlistedFileStillFails adds assets/stray.png and expects code import_unlisted_file to be raised.
OpenRegularFile_MapsErrnoToAccurateCodes expects a missing path to raise the code import_file_missing.
OpenRegularFile_MapsErrnoToAccurateCodes expects a symbolic link to a regular file to raise import_unsafe_path.
OpenRegularFile_MapsErrnoToAccurateCodes expects opening a real file holding one byte to report a Length of 1.
OpenRegularFile_MapsErrnoToAccurateCodes expects a file with mode None to raise import_unreadable_file when the user is not root.
Import_LargeEmbeddedAssetStaysWithinAllocationBudget runs one import into a discarded TempDb before measuring bytes allocated on the current thread.
Import_LargeEmbeddedAssetStaysWithinAllocationBudget asserts the joined skip reasons are empty and result.Blobs is 1.
ReadAtMost_StopsOnAnEndlessStream repeats the check with a limit of 1000 and still expects null and fewer than 8192 bytes served.
AssetCopyLimit_NeverExceedsWhatTheHandleHolds expects a handle of length 0 to yield a copy limit of 0 when the declared size is 1_000_000_000_000.
AssetCopyLimit_NeverExceedsWhatTheHandleHolds expects AssetCopyLimit(10, 100) to be 10 and AssetCopyLimit(100, 10) to be 10.
AssetCopyLimit_NeverExceedsWhatTheHandleHolds expects a declared size of -1 with a handle length of 5 to yield 5.
CopyAtMost_WithAssetCopyLimitStopsOnZeroLengthEndlessHandle expects nothing copied, the handle serving less than 1L << 20, and CopyAtMost to report false.
Import_AssetFileEmptyButDeclaredHugeIsSkippedPromptlyWithoutTempFile empties the single asset file and rewrites its bytes value to 1000000000000.
Import_AssetFileEmptyButDeclaredHugeIsSkippedPromptlyWithoutTempFile throws TimeoutException when the import does not return within 10 seconds.
at: throw new TimeoutException("import did not return promptly")

facts.text: Import_AssetFileEmptyButDeclaredHugeIsSkippedPromptlyWithoutTempFile expects 0 blobs, at least 1 skipped entry and no files left under the blobs directory.
UnixOpenFlags_ExplicitTableRows expects macos with Arm64 or X64 to resolve to 0x1000104.
UnixOpenFlags_ExplicitTableRows expects freebsd with X64 or Arm64 to resolve to 0x100104.
UnixOpenFlags_ExplicitTableRows expects linux with X64 to resolve to 0x80000 | 0x20000 | 0x800.
UnixOpenFlags_ExplicitTableRows expects linux with Arm64 to resolve to 0x80000 | 0x8000 | 0x800.
UnixOpenFlags_UnknownPlatformFailsClosed expects ios, illumos, other and an empty os string all to raise import_unsupported_platform.
UnixOpenFlags_UnknownPlatformFailsClosed counts linux with Architecture.Wasm and with Ppc64le + 99 as unsupported.
UnixOpenFlags_CurrentHostResolvesToItsRow requires a nonzero intersection of the flags with 0x4 or 0x800 and, on macOS, flags equal to 0x1000104.
Import_ManifestSymlinkToHugeFileIsRefusedRegardlessOfSize symlinks manifest.json to a 65 times 1024 times 1024 byte file and expects import_unsafe_path.
Import_ManifestSymlinkToHugeFileIsRefusedRegardlessOfSize runs the same refusal check once for the jsonl format and once for md.
JsonlRound3Tests.EndlessZeroLengthStream throws InvalidOperationException past 1 GiB with a message saying the copy limit ignored the handle length.
at: read past 1 GiB: the copy limit ignored the handle length

facts.text: UnixOpenFlags_CurrentHostResolvesToItsRow picks macos, freebsd or linux from OperatingSystem before resolving flags for the process architecture.
